title: A Star Orbits a Black Hole at 5,000 Miles Per Second

scenes.text: One star races past a black hole at 5,000 miles per second.
It's called S4716, and it circles the black hole at the center of our galaxy.
One lap takes only four years.
At its closest, it's still about a hundred times farther out than Earth is from the Sun.
That speed is roughly three percent of the speed of light.
Five thousand miles every second, around a black hole.

description:
The star S4716 orbits the black hole at the center of our galaxy at about 5,000 miles per second.

Would you fly past a black hole?
